remarks: Beautifully refreshed and move-in ready, this spacious first-floor 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo is set in the sought after Ledgebrook community. With a bright open floor plan, the living room features a cozy fireplace and sliders leading to a private patio overlooking the tranquil brook, the perfect spot to enjoy nature year round. A formal dining area flows seamlessly from the living room, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. This unit has been thoughtfully updated with all new wood flooring throughout, fresh paint, new lighting fixtures, and a new stainless steel dishwasher. The eat-in kitchen also features brand-new flooring, providing a fresh and inviting space. Both bedrooms are generously sized and privately situated at opposite ends of the unit, with the primary suite offering double closets (including a walk-in) and serene brook views. Additional highlights include in unit laundry, a private storage room, and a one-car garage with plenty of guest parking.  Residents of Ledgebrook enjoy resort style amenities including a pool, spa, exercise room, library and scenic walking paths around the beautifully landscaped grounds with an aerated lake and charming bridge. A wonderful opportunity to own in one of Norwalk's most desirable complexes, just minutes from shopping, dining, and commuting options.
